33% !
Approximately 33% of U.S.
residents are non-drivers,
which includes children,
older adults, people with
disabilities, and people
who do not have access to
a personal vehicle. Safe
Routes to Everyday
Destinations makes it
easier for non-drivers to
move around their
communities and
increases access to
essential services.
Quick Check
What are some of the
everyday destinations in
your community? Why are
they important? Learn
more about how
improving access to
everyday destinations can
boost physical activity.

Safe Routes
Across Colorado
In 2024, four communities
participated in the Safe
Routes to Parks Activating
Communities Program.
The City of Boulder, the
Town of Paonia, the Town
of Wellington, and the City
of Wheat Ridge worked
with state partners and the
Safe Routes Partnership to
improve safety access to
local parks. Read more
about how they took early
action steps to create long-
term change.
